name: opencode-arch
description: Architecture context compression, validation, and code quality tools

tools.name: architect_scan
tools.description: Scan a repository to generate its reality manifest (AST analysis). Returns modules, functions, classes, imports, metrics, and suggested component groupings.

tools.name: architect_slice
tools.description: Generate an optimized context slice from a repository. Compresses the full repository into a dense context string within the token budget.

tools.name: architect_validate
tools.description: Validate an architecture model for structural correctness. Returns score 0-100 with detailed issues.

tools.name: architect_extract
tools.description: Store a validated architecture extraction. Validates, writes to .architecture-model.yaml, and records telemetry.

tools.name: architect_generate
tools.description: Run tests on generated code to verify quality. Returns pass rate, failures, and total test count.

tools.name: architect_group
tools.description: Group repository modules into logical architecture components using multi-signal affinity analysis.

tools.name: architect_check
tools.description: Verify model representativeness against code reality. Returns file coverage, relationship accuracy, and boundary coherence scores (target: 100%).
